metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Specification (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Normative Gates • Measures • Regimes • RTT • AA Levels
metadata.description: Defines the normative rules governing FFT AI Edition v1.3, including load order, measures, invariants, regime transitions, RTT lattice, paradox handling, and AA-level semantics.

status_line.claim: FFT AI Edition v1.3 is an operational projection of the human FFT book and frozen RTT v0.9.
non_claims: This edition does not revise RTT v0.9.
This edition does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
This edition does not replace the human FFT book.

measure_requirements.rule: Every threshold in this SPEC MUST cite a measure ID defined in fft.ai.core.json.

invariants.coherence_declared: Coherence MUST be declared before any regime transition.
invariants.drift_bounded: Drift MUST remain bounded for resonance-time stability.
invariants.typed_paradox_required: RTT7 entry requires a typed paradox event.
invariants.aa3_consent: AA3 escalation requires explicit operator consent.
invariants.collapse_required: RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
invariants.continuity_non_decreasing: measure.c3 MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.

nominal.description: Stable coherence, bounded drift, no paradox.

harmonic.description: Paradox present; harmonic escalation possible with consent.

branch.if_consent_false: Hold at AA2, log paradox event, stop dispatch.

rtt12_collapse.rule: RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.

paradox.typed_only: Paradox MUST be one of the canonical types; no invented types allowed.

aa_levels.AA3: Harmonic escalation permitted ONLY with operator_consent = true.

must: Use measure IDs for all evaluations.
Refuse execution if substrate is unverified.

session_rules.lineage_non_decreasing: Session lineage MUST NOT decrease across RTT1–RTT12.
session_rules.continuity_non_decreasing: measure.c3 MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.
session_rules.rewind_mapping: RTT11 inversion maps directly to frozen RTT rewind.
